newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Spanish-led group buys Rio state gas firms-bolsa.
newsitem.headline: Spanish-led group buys Rio state gas firms-bolsa.

text.p: A Spanish-led consortium bought a controlling stake in Rio de Janeiro state gas firms Companhia Estadual de Gas (CEG) and Riogas for 622.2 million reais, the Rio de Janeiro Stock Exchange said.
The consortium, including Spain's Gas Natural SDG SA, U.S. firm Enron Corp and Argentine Pluspetrol Energy SA, paid 74.8 percent more than the minimum price of 355.8 million reais for both companies.
Rio state was offering 56.4 percent of CEG's voting shares for a base price of 250 million reais and 83.67 percent of Riogas' voting capital for at least 105.8 million reais.
The closed-envelope privatization auction took place shortly after the Rio de Janeiro state government managed to lift a court injunction blocking the sale.
The CEG/Riogas privatization was the first of a Brazilian state-owned gas company and the third held by the Rio de Janeiro state.
((--Simona de Logu, Rio de Janeiro newsroom 5521 5074151))
